title: Column
description: A cool near-white bank page: deep navy ink for headings and the filled CTA, grey-blue body text, white buttons on hairline rings and #eeeff2 tiles, 8px corners and whisper-quiet depth. Each section gets a small accent (teal-green, blue, lime, orange, purple, crimson). Dark sibling: the deep teal band from the middle of the page, with pale cyan and mint for emphasis.
notes: light is the faithful mode; .dark is the original's dark teal band, which column-infrastructure uses on its own
Host Grotesk stands in for Suisse Int'l (closed); Source Code Pro for Suisse Int'l Mono and SF Mono
chart-1…5 are the section accents: blue, lime-green, orange, purple, crimson; highlight is the teal-green of the stats
name: column-theme
